title: From Voice to Value: Leveraging AI to Enhance Spoken Online Reviews on the Go
abstract: arXiv:2412.05445v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Online reviews help people make better decisions. Review platforms usually depend on typed input, where leaving a good review requires significant effort because users must carefully organize and articulate their thoughts. This may discourage users from leaving comprehensive and high-quality reviews, especially when they are on the go. To address this challenge, we developed Vocalizer, a mobile application that enables users to provide reviews through voice input, with enhancements from a large language model (LLM). In a longitudinal study, we analysed user interactions with the app, focusing on AI-driven features that help refine and improve reviews. Our findings show that users frequently utilized the AI agent to add more detailed information to their reviews. translated_title: 从语音到价值：利用人工智能增强移动场景下的语音在线评论
translated_abstract: 在线评论帮助人们做出更好的决策。评论平台通常依赖打字输入，撰写一条优质评论需要付出大量努力，因为用户必须仔细组织并清晰地表达自己的想法。这可能会阻碍用户留下全面且高质量的评论，尤其是在他们移动途中时。为了解决这一挑战，我们开发了Vocalizer，这是一款移动应用程序，允许用户通过语音输入提供评论，并由大语言模型（LLM）进行增强。在一项纵向研究中，我们分析了用户与应用程序的交互，重点关注帮助完善和改进评论的AI驱动功能。我们的研究结果表明，用户频繁使用AI代理为其评论添加更详细的信息。我们还展示了交互式AI功能如何提升用户的自我效能感和在线分享评论的意愿。最后，我们讨论了这一方向带来的机遇与挑战。
tldr: 该研究开发了结合大语言模型的语音评论移动应用Vocalizer，发现语音输入结合AI增强功能能显著提升评论的详细程度、用户的自我效能感以及在线分享评论的意愿。
en_tdlr: This study developed Vocalizer, a mobile voice-review app enhanced by large language models, showing that AI-assisted voice input increases review detail, user self-efficacy, and willingness to share reviews online.
